title: Deep Sea Cable Splicer
one_line: 심해 작업대에서 해저 케이블을 절개하고 광섬유를 직접 짝지어 압착해 신호를 복구하는 모바일 수리 퍼즐.
player_fantasy: 플레이어는 심해 통신 수리기사다. 복잡한 케이블 속 규칙을 읽고 손으로 정리·접속해 죽은 신호가 살아나는 공학적 만족을 느낀다.
core_loop: 케이블 확인→피복 절개→4–6가닥 펼치기→신호 규칙을 보고 대응 가닥을 drag/snap→압착→Test→오류 가닥만 재작업→복구. 세션 3 케이블.
round_structure: Job 시작 시 sealed cable과 manifest가 생성. Strip→Routing→Locked/Test→Rework(optional)→Result. 모든 required channel 통과 성공. Rework token 2개 소진 후 test 실패면 job 실패. 60–120초/job, 4–6분/session.

game_rules.test: each locked pair computes compatibility minus attenuation; pass >=0.8
game_rules.reset: retry restores sheath, fibers, tokens and manifest initial state
game_rules.failure: failed test with zero rework tokens
game_rules.recovery: failed pair is identified by waveform channel; long-press unlock costs 1 token; reroute then reclamp

trigger_rules.crossing: more than 2 fiber crossings adds 0.15 attenuation per excess crossing
trigger_rules.damaged_strip: blade leaves strip corridor for 150ms; one fiber gets 0.25 attenuation

route.cancel: release off-slot returns to last rest position
route.invalid: occupied slot rejects and returns fiber

strip.invalid: 150ms outside causes damage once per strip

interaction_spec.rework: long-press failed locked pair 300ms; costs token only when unlock completes
interaction_spec.priority: dragged fiber captures pointer; test disabled until required pairs locked

difficulty_variation: 초반은 색 직접 매칭 4가닥, 중반은 색 대신 symbol/signature remap, 후반은 6가닥과 crossing attenuation으로 공간 정리를 요구한다. 속도보다 정보 규칙과 배선 topology를 어렵게 한다.
progression: MVP는 3 jobs 순차 해금과 best repair grade. 이후 장비/기지 구역 해금 가능.
screen_flow: Job Select→Sealed/Strip→Routing→ReadyTest→Pass Result 또는 Failed Test→Rework→ReadyTest. tokens 0에서 재실패→Fail Result. Retry는 job 전체 reset.
visual_direction_brief: Portrait mobile workbench close-up. 검은 심해 장비와 밝은 fiber glow 대비. Fiber end와 slot이 손가락 아래에서도 구분되도록 굵은 실루엣과 충분한 간격을 유지하되 좌표는 Wireframe에서 결정. Waveform은 진단 의미만 명확히.
mvp_scope: 3 jobs: 4-fiber direct color, 4-fiber symbol remap, 6-fiber crossing-sensitive. Strip damage, routing/snap, clamp, test, 2 rework tokens, pass/fail/result/retry를 구현.
test_scenarios: 세 jobs 모두 규칙만 읽고 완주 가능
invalid slot release가 항상 원위치로 복귀
rework token 감소와 terminal failure가 일관됨
wireframe_handoff: terminal fail and full retry reset
primary_interaction: 피복 drag 절개 + 광섬유 drag/snap 배선 + clamp/test/rework
design_markdown:
# Playable Game Design Spec v0.1 — Deep Sea Cable Splicer

## 1. Product Definition
해저 케이블을 손으로 절개·배선·압착하는 portrait mobile repair puzzle, 4–6분. Non-goals: 선택지 게임, 경영, 실시간 액션.
## 2. Player Fantasy
심해 통신 수리기사로서 복잡한 신호 규칙을 읽고 죽은 회선을 살린다.
## 3. Core Player Verbs
Strip(drag), Route(drag/snap), Splice(hold clamp), Test(tap), Rework(long-press). 각 행동은 cable state/assignment/token을 변경한다.
## 4. Core Loop
확인→절개→4–6 fibers 배선→압착→test→오류 rework→복구. 3 jobs/session.
## 5. Round / Session Structure
Sealed→Routing→ReadyTest→Rework(optional)→Result. 60–120초/job. Next/Retry.
## 6. Game Rules
Rework 2. Strip corridor 20px; 150ms 이탈은 한 fiber attenuation +0.25. Bad pair는 signature mismatch. 2개 초과 crossing마다 attenuation +0.15. Signal >=0.8 pass. Failed channel은 waveform으로 특정. Unlock 완료 시 token -1. Token 0에서 재실패하면 terminal fail. Retry full reset.
## 7. State Model
Sealed(strip), Routing(route/snap/clamp), ReadyTest(test), Rework(unlock/reroute), Result(next/retry). Pause 시 모든 timers/animation simulation 정지.
## 8. Interaction Spec
Strip은 seam corridor forward drag. Lift는 pause. Fiber는 empty slot 24px snap; occupied rejects and returns. Clamp hold 400ms locks. Dragged fiber pointer priority. Test는 required pairs locked 전 disabled. Rework long-press 300ms.
## 9. Content Model
Job = fiber count×signature mapping×crossing constraint×damage×slot order. MVP 3 authored jobs.
## 10. Difficulty / Variation
4 direct color→4 symbol remap→6 crossing-sensitive. Speed-only scaling 없음.
## 11. Progression
3 jobs sequential unlock+best grade.
## 12. Economy
Not required.
## 13. Screen Inventory
Job Select, Splice Workbench, Job Result.
## 14. Screen Flow
Select→Strip→Routing→Test→Pass Result 또는 Rework→Test; tokens 0 fail→Result; Retry full reset.
## 15. Feedback System
Sheath peel/damage tick, slot glow/snap, clamp pulse, waveform sweep, failed-channel isolation, clean signal success.
## 16. Visual Direction Brief
Portrait close-up workbench, dark deep-sea hardware vs luminous fibers, thick readable endpoints/slots, diagnostic waveform without layout prescription.
## 17. MVP Scope
3 jobs: 4 direct, 4 remap, 6 crossing. Strip damage, route/snap, clamp, test, 2 tokens, result/retry. NOT IN MVP: procedural, economy, upgrades, narrative, >6 fibers, timed mode.
## 18. Test Scenarios
All jobs complete; invalid slot always returns; failed test identifies channel; token/terminal fail consistent; pause/retry deterministic.
## 19. Known Risks
Occlusion, color accessibility, crossing mismatch, repetitive stripping.
## 20. Wireframe Handoff
Show all screens/states, strip damage/cancel, route snap/reject, clamp/test lock, waveform diagnosis, token use, terminal fail, full retry reset. No game-rule invention required.
